split_strategy: Campaign-Aware Temporal Zero-Day Partition (Zero Domain Leakage)

Traditional ML (Random Forest).description: Random Forest trained on lexical URL and structural HTML features.
Traditional ML (Random Forest).zero_day_note: Fails on newly minted/unseen zero-day domains that lack lexical anomalies or domain history.

URL Heuristics Modality.description: Lexical entropy, suspicious TLDs, and subdomain token inspection.
URL Heuristics Modality.zero_day_note: Identifies suspicious TLDs but misses zero-day phishing on free/PaaS cloud platforms.

HTML Structural Modality.description: Form action discrepancy, password inputs, and iframe anomalies.
HTML Structural Modality.zero_day_note: Flags cross-domain form submission, but cannot verify visual brand identity.

Text / Semantic Modality.description: Urgency, account suspension threats, and credential requests.
Text / Semantic Modality.zero_day_note: Captures psychological coercion, but produces false positives on legitimate notices.

DOM & Visual Brand Discrepancy.description: Cross-modal brand identity discrepancy vs. registrable apex domain.
DOM & Visual Brand Discrepancy.zero_day_note: High zero-day detection: catches unauthorized brand impersonation regardless of domain age.

Complete Multimodal Fusion (Aegis-VLM).description: Unified fusion of URL, DOM, Semantic, and Visual brand evidence with bounded rules.
Complete Multimodal Fusion (Aegis-VLM).zero_day_note: Optimal Zero-Day performance: eliminates blind spots through multi-layer corroboration.
